test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 25 July 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Select the letter-cluster from among the given options that can replace the question mark (?) in the following series.

ABCD, YZEF, WXGH, UVIJ, ?
solution:
According to the English alphabets and their positional values:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2279b560b10991887192eff3a548e57e9b0820d787d416555b032b86f014a220.png] 

The pattern followed in the given series is:

 
• **First and second alphabets are decreased to 2 positional values.**
 
• **Third and fourth alphabets are increased to 2 positional values.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d0375a0ef92fa23099614ea73ececd56dbd6a511972692be5241d43201e4c3e8.png] 

Hence **the correct answer is option 1)**
